correctness.rationale: Permutation symmetry at the uniform distribution forces the Hessian on the tangent hyperplane to be a scalar. Along \(t(e_a-e_b)\), the source-form pair-merging polynomial depends on \(c=1/4-q^2t^2/4\); differentiating its exact positive-coefficient expression gives \(P_s'(1/4)=\frac{2s(s-1)}{2s-1}2^{-s}\binom{2s}{s}\). Averaging over the merged occupancy yields the stated finite sum and hence \(C_{d,q}=q^2\gamma_{d,q}>0\). The conversion from probability coordinates to squared-amplitude perturbations is \(h=v/q\). Independent exact direct Hessian enumeration reproduces the formula for \((d,q)=(2,3),(3,5),(4,5)\), giving respectively \(1,33/5,858/25\) for \(C_{d,q}\); for \(d=2\) the source-form functional is exactly quadratic. The finite checks validate the algebra only; the symmetry/pair-merging proof is all-parameter.
